inputs.original_text: Introduced as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, the proposed legislation would require guns sold in New York to be designed so they cannot be easily modified into illegal machine guns and would establish criminal penalties for...
inputs.modified_text: Albany is using public safety as cover for another assault on lawful gun ownership. The proposal would dictate how firearms sold in New York are designed and add criminal penalties, yet the account itself cannot say who would actually be punished. That kind of vagueness invites arbitrary enforcement and puts responsible owners and manufacturers in the government’s crosshairs. If lawmakers want to stop criminals, they should target illegal modifications—not burden citizens who follow the law. Clear rules and equal justice are essential to public order; treating ordinary people as suspects is not.
